state.task: Fix the 3F L plan dimensions inside the original over-track box (신맞이방). Station frame: +u north, +v east. Box inner walls: south wall u about -18 (inner face u=-0.0696v-14.05), east wall v=0.0722u+94.29 (about 93-99), west face v about 15-20, north door line u about 66. 3F floor level 12.2.

facts.O1_roof: Original roof underside: low 16-19 m over the east band (v 88-96, all u) and over the south band (u -21..-2, all v). Raised 23-26 m over u 2..56, v 42..88 (the void). A 3F unit may extend under the raised-roof edge; the low roof alone does not bound the slab.
facts.O2_partition: The original model has one 3F-height partition line at u about -6, running v 15..33, present at 14.5 m only.
facts.O3_windows: The original east wall carries a continuous glass band at 3F height (food-court windows facing the North Port park).
facts.B1_board: Official 3F board (2026-04, schematic). The band along the east holds 1 푸드코트 (north part) and 2 비빔가 (south part) with an entrance door between them. A 전문식당가 corridor runs along the band void side. The escalator arrives in the corridor near the corner. The wing runs from the corner west along the south side: elevator, toilets, 3 부산옥, elevator, 4 에그박스. A narrow grey strip lies south of the wing, and the large grey void lies north-west of the L.
facts.B2_board_scaled: Scaled to the box extents (unreliable, schematic): food court u 14..53, entrance door u 11.5, 비빔가 u -12..9, wing u -6..2, grey strip u -18..-6.
facts.L1_leases: Leases: food court 787 m2, 비빔가 428.2 m2, 부산옥 86.7 m2, eggbox 230.6 m2.
facts.P1_photos: Photos and 2023 video: food-court seating runs along the east window wall; the corridor has the lattice roof overhead; from the escalator top you face the wing, with 부산옥 then eggbox on the left and the railing on the right.
facts.C1_area_implications: Computed unit areas per option, using board-scaled lengths (food court 39 m, 비빔가 21 m) and the east wall at v about 95.5 with a 3.5-4 m corridor: v88_to_wall: unit depth 4.0 m, food court 156 m2 (lease 787), 비빔가 84 m2 (lease 428); v82_to_wall: unit depth 9.5 m, food court 370 m2 (lease 787), 비빔가 200 m2 (lease 428); v70_to_wall: unit depth 21.5 m, food court 838 m2 (lease 787), 비빔가 452 m2 (lease 428)
facts.C2_video_depth: 2023 walk video: the food-court interior reads about 20 m deep from its corridor-side glass front to the east window wall.
